response.reasoning: Verified in the diff: `admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `templates/embedding.hbs` contains no button or action bound to `saveChanges` (only `addHost`, `deleteHost`, and per-host save/cancel in the embeddable-host component). Server-side, `embedding_controller.rb#update` only calls `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` — it performs no persistence, unlike `embeddable_hosts_controller` which actually saves. So the PUT /customize/embedding route is a genuine no-op endpoint and saveChanges is dead code. This is not incorrect behavior currently reachable by users (nothing invokes it), but it is a specific, actionable concern: a maintainer wiring up a save button would silently persist nothing, and the no-op PUT endpoint is shipped in config/routes.rb. Real, specific, decision-relevant, and not style.
